freeze_prerequisites: Final 742 GLB, runtime, CSS, machine modules, configuration, and mechanism bytes are committed.
A pending candidate receipt has been regenerated from that exact tree with frozen-source verification.
The current 600S and ES1930M release receipts and runtime bytes are unchanged during capture.
The local static server is addressed by one recorded origin and every route uses diagnostics=1 where supported.

common_capture.gpu_metadata: Record WebGL API plus unmasked vendor/renderer when WEBGL_debug_renderer_info is observable; otherwise record unavailable and the exact reason.
common_capture.accessibility_tree_slider_contract: Normalize raw Chromium CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree nodes without inventing display units. Every expected slider name must match exactly; each slider must be enabled, focusable, settable, and retain its finite native numeric value plus equivalent numeric AX valuetext. Unit-suffixed or semantic presentation text is verified separately from the DOM aria-valuetext attribute.
common_capture.automation: Record tool and version, one structured JSON trace per gate, UTC capture time, and exact screenshots in BROWSER_CAPTURE_ALLOWLIST.json.
boundaries: local browser or responsive emulation only
no VoiceOver or NVDA session claim

semantic_selection.raw_ray_rule: Copy and parse data-selection-overlap-outcomes for all 15 rays. The validator independently recomputes the expected component from hit components/distances, visible-surface component, the fixed 0.025 m tie rule, and its own priority map.

performance_profile.summary_rule: Nearest-rank p95 and worst value rounded to 0.001 ms must be recomputed from the committed raw interval arrays.
